resources.string: Boats at a berth, closely spaced sites, or a single building.
Small sites, a house and yard, or a marina office.
Most work: shops, offices, homes. The default.
Large sites such as a campus, hospital or depot.
Farms, quarries or sprawling sites where you walk around a lot.
Below 100 m: Android geofences are less reliable at that size, so a departure may be noticed late, and tracking closely again can use more battery.
